environment.description: Go 1.21 microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) with a public Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no network ACL restrictions. The service is directly internet-facing. The audit log file is writable and the process runs as a non-root user with write access to /var/log/app/.
